blocks.prompt: 7. 15 members of a club form 4 committees of 3, 5, 4, 3 members so that no member is a member of more than one committee. Find the number of committees.
blocks.explanation:
Har member sirf ek committee mein jayega, to 15 members ko 3, 5, 4 aur 3 ke groups mein baantna hai.
Find kya karna hai? Committees banane ke kul tareeqe, yani members ko in chaar groups mein kitne tareeqon se baanta ja sakta hai.
Plan: har member ko ek committee ka label de dein; labels ek 'lafz' ban jate hain jis mein letters dohraye gaye hain, phir wohi 'objects not all different' wala formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 15 members; committees ke size 3, 5, 4, 3; koi member do committees mein nahi.
Humein find karna hai: committees banane ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: 15 members ko line mein khara kar ke har ek ko label dein: 3 ko \(A\), 5 ko \(B\), 4 ko \(C\), 3 ko \(D\). Labels ki har tarteeb committees banane ka ek tareeqa hai, is liye ginti \(\dfrac{15!}{3!\,5!\,4!\,3!}\) hai.

Check karein ke sab shamil hain
\[3 + 5 + 4 + 3 = 15\]
Kyun: Sizes ka jama 15 hai, yani koi member bahar nahi rehta aur koi do jagah nahi aata. Yahi sawal ki shart hai. Agar jama 15 se kam hota to kuch members kisi committee mein na jate aur hisaab ka tareeqa badal jata.

Formula lagayen
\[\dfrac{15!}{3!\,5!\,4!\,3!} = \dfrac{1307674368000}{6 \cdot 120 \cdot 24 \cdot 6}\]
\[= \dfrac{1307674368000}{103680}\]
\[= 12612600\]
Kyun: Ek committee ke andar members ki tarteeb ka koi farq nahi (Ali, Sara, Hina wali committee aur Sara, Hina, Ali wali committee ek hi hai). Is liye har committee ke size ka factorial neeche aata hai, bilkul jaise aik jaise letters ka.

Tasdeeq: ek ek committee chun kar
\[{}^{15}C_3 \cdot {}^{12}C_5 \cdot {}^{7}C_4 \cdot {}^{3}C_3\]
\[= 455 \cdot 792 \cdot 35 \cdot 1\]
\[= 12612600 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehli committee ke liye 15 mein se 3 chunein, doosri ke liye bache 12 mein se 5, teesri ke liye bache 7 mein se 4, aur aakhri 3 khud chauthi committee ban jate hain. Har marhale ke baad chune gaye members hat jate hain, isi liye 15, phir 12, phir 7, phir 3. Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaya, jo is baat ka saboot hai ke labels wala tareeqa sahi hai.
Dhyan dein: Yeh jawab (aur kitab ka jawab) chaaron committees ko alag alag (jaise naam wali) committees maanta hai. Agar 3 members wali do committees mein koi farq na kiya jaye to jawab ko 2! se aur divide karna parta.
